name: Nova
tagline: Your work, tailored to the opportunity.

description.project: Nova turns a candidate's existing experience and GitHub projects into resumes tailored to specific job descriptions.
description.technical: A full-stack Next.js application that connects to GitHub through OAuth, reads structured project metadata, stores candidate profiles in PostgreSQL, and uses OpenRouter models to analyze job descriptions and generate structured, role-specific resumes with PDF previews.

highlights: Connects a GitHub account through OAuth to retrieve the candidate's repositories.
Uses repository-level nova.json files to represent projects as structured, schema-validated data.
Runs a multi-stage AI workflow to analyze a job description, select and tailor relevant projects, and generate a targeted resume.
Keeps candidate details, education, experience, links, and project information in a structured PostgreSQL-backed profile.
Generates an A4 resume preview and PDF from validated resume data.

features.name: GitHub Integration
features.description: Connect a GitHub account and retrieve the user's repositories for use as resume project sources.
features.implementation: Uses Better Auth's GitHub OAuth integration and the GitHub REST API to access repository data on the server.

features.name: Structured Project Metadata
features.description: Represent each repository as a structured project with its description, technologies, features, links, and highlights.
features.implementation: Reads a root-level nova.json from repositories and validates project data against a shared Zod schema.

features.name: Job Description Analysis
features.description: Extract the role, requirements, and relevant technical context from a job description before resume generation.
features.implementation: Uses an OpenRouter model to analyze the job description and return structured output validated against a Zod schema.

features.name: AI Project Tailoring
features.description: Select and adapt the candidate's most relevant projects for a specific vacancy while keeping the content grounded in supplied project information.
features.implementation: Uses a separate LLM stage to rank relevant projects and rewrite their descriptions and highlights for the target role.

features.name: Structured Resume Generation
features.description: Generate a role-specific resume using the candidate's profile, education, experience, and tailored projects.
features.implementation: Combines stored candidate data with the analyzed job and tailored projects, then validates the generated resume against a Zod schema.

features.name: Resume PDF Preview
features.description: Preview and export the generated resume in an A4 document layout.
features.implementation: Renders validated resume data as a paginated PDF document with clickable links.
